_comment: Adaptive failure-response mode (--adaptive). All probabilities are hand-set priors (hypotheses, not fitted). States: receptive, frustrated, disengaging. Actions: a1 silent, a2 explain, a3 explain + alternative, a4 explain + offer retry, a5 explain + apologise. The first baseline_episodes failures follow a counterbalanced schedule (Williams design over a1-a5; row chosen like the condition order: --balanced by participant number, --order N forces row N, else random); later failures are chosen by the policy.
_comment_emission: P(observation | state) per channel. Emotion: soft evidence, the confidence-weighted share of the reaction window (failure message -> decision) spent in each stable emotion. Fear/surprise ('ambiguous'), low confidence and 'no face' carry no evidence (equal likelihood in every state).
_comment_transition: Prior P(next state | state, action): 'default' rows, overridden per action. prior_strength = pseudo-observations per row; the robot's per-user model starts here and is updated after every failure.
_comment_reward: Desires: reward = progress[decision] + engagement * (P'(receptive) - P'(disengaging)) + affect * emotion_valence - action_cost. reward_prior: prior mean reward per state and action (hypotheses), reward_prior_count pseudo-observations, reward_noise_sd for Thompson sampling.
_comment_heuristic: Rules are checked in order; the first match whose action is allowed wins. when: frustration_rising (P(frustrated) rose by more than 'threshold' at the last update), most_likely (argmax belief == state), last_decision (previous failure ended with 'decision'), always.
